hypothesis: A mandatory transferable Reach head can be jointly fitted with the MINERAL_LIFETIME process and strongly-shrunk site residual without relying on held-out-year TN.

fit_contract.feature_preprocessing: fold-local p01/p99 winsorization, centering and scaling learned only from training reaches

resource_revision.reason: live three-worker test reached approximately 42 GiB and was stopped before checkpoints; all official fits run serially

optimizer_engineering_amendment.change: increase block-coordinate refinement ceiling from 8 to 10 cycles, permit deterministic component-wise physical-gradient secant proposals after two accepted block iterates, and use acceptance-gated bounded Gauss-Seidel physical-coordinate repair when full KKT is at most 5e-3
optimizer_engineering_amendment.reason: H7 T1 KKT decreased monotonically with an approximately 0.4 contraction per cycle, implying both that eight cycles could stop immediately above the unchanged 1e-5 gate and that gradient-root extrapolation can avoid repeated 30-forward-evaluation line searches
optimizer_engineering_amendment.acceptance: an accelerated proposal is accepted only after refitting the full gamma/site head and only when the unchanged objective does not increase and the independently recomputed full projected KKT strictly decreases
optimizer_engineering_amendment.interrupted_fit_recovery: the unfinished H7 T1 run wrote no formal checkpoint; its completed per-cycle physical coordinates and physical gradients are recoverable from the append-only stdout log and may seed the same acceptance-gated acceleration
optimizer_engineering_amendment.discarded_engineering_probe: a coordinate-only Aitken proposal was tested before any final prediction, increased KKT from 1.91e-4 to 6.38e-4, wrote no formal checkpoint and was discarded
optimizer_engineering_amendment.coordinate_repair_precedent: same unchanged-objective bounded physical-coordinate rescue previously passed the 20260902_5 nested-fold numerical audit; each proposal here must additionally reduce the independently recomputed full KKT after gamma/site refitting
optimizer_engineering_amendment.serialization_fix: after H7 T1 achieved KKT 2.36e-6 but before any formal output was written, audit_json exposed NumPy int64 training-Reach identifiers; FoldDesign now converts them to native int without changing values, preprocessing or predictions
optimizer_engineering_amendment.coordinate_control_flow_fix: before H7 T2 wrote any final checkpoint, four accepted coordinate repairs reduced KKT to 3.45e-4 but a rejected repeat of beta_low incorrectly forced an immediate full-block fallback; rejected coordinates are now skipped within the sweep so other residual coordinates are tested, and only an exhausted sweep may fall back
optimizer_engineering_amendment.near_optimum_block_cap: after acceptance-gated coordinate sweeps, any remaining full physical fallback uses at most 8 strong-Wolfe iterations per cycle instead of 24; the unchanged full KKT gate, not iteration count, determines completion
optimizer_engineering_amendment.temporal_failed_checkpoint_repair: If a saved final temporal solution is finite and mass-closed but misses the unchanged 1e-5 projected-KKT gate, resume from that saved solution rather than repeating the five starts. Alternate the exact cached gamma/site head with bounded physical-scale L-BFGS-B on the six non-profiled interior process coordinates. Each proposal is accepted only when the unchanged full objective does not increase and independently recomputed full projected KKT strictly decreases; a 24-iteration physical Torch L-BFGS fallback is allowed under the same acceptance gate. Held-out predictions are regenerated only after the numerical gate passes.

selection_policy: Only population-transferable temporal and later nested spatial evidence may select H7/H14/H22; no-head is diagnostic-only.
